about_the_game:
Balance your gaming passion with life's priorities. Sentinel Signal helps you track, manage, and optimize your gaming time without limiting your enjoyment.

Game Detection

Automatically detects when you're gaming for accurate time tracking. All Steam games are supported by automatic game detection.

Mindful Gaming Framework

Set weekly goals that fit your lifestyle and track progress toward balanced gaming.

Flexible Time Extensions

Need 15 more minutes to finish that match? No problem. Extend your session when needed.

Sound Indicators for Reaching Your Daily Limit

Sentinel Signal will start informing you with a bell sound without disrupting your game when you are close to the limit you set for today. It will alarm you at 5 minute left, 2 minute left, 0 minute left.

Auto Game Shutdown

If you don't want to extend your game session, when the time is past 4 minute into your limit Sentinel Signal will automatically shutdown your game. You should ensure that your game is saved before the shutdown.

Time Wallet System

Had a busy week and could not really play your favorite games? Don't worry, you can save unused gaming time for later use. Your play time will accumulate in your Time Wallet over the long run. Perfect for busy weeks and gaming weekends.

Visual Progress Tracking

See your gaming time with intuitive visual indicators and progress bars.

Strategic Breaks

Take scheduled 5-minute breaks to rest your eyes and stretch without losing your flow.
